pages.title: Comfort Items
pages.text: Plush companions for long solo operations.

pages.title: Why
pages.text: Long solo work causes strain. Approved coping: talking to yourself, naming your tools, and plush companions.$(br2)Carriers file $(bold)23% fewer$() incident reports.$(br2)$(flavor)You are not going crazy. Probably.$()
$(flavor)Holds up well in the cold, for obvious reasons.$()
$(flavor)Certified emotional support animal. Does not judge you. Cannot judge you. Is wool.$()
$(flavor)The elephant's closest living relative. ORSA Zoology can't explain it either.$()

pages.title: Jar of Miel
pages.text: Found, never issued. Eight spoonfuls. Each one feeds a little and keeps you warm for half a minute.$(br2)$(flavor)Honey recovered from ancient tombs was still edible. ORSA declined to test this one.$()

pages.title: Personal Effects
pages.text: Not ORSA issue. The jars turn up in personal lockers, never in supply manifests. Each label is handwritten in the same careful hand.$(br2)Field staff keep the jar long after it is empty. ORSA has stopped asking why.
